aboutPage.purposeBody: Ensuring employment is a right, not a privilege. We facilitate adaptive labor insertion by acorganizationing individuals with diverse cognitive styles to enhance their capabilities and helping companies build spaces where all ways of thinking and learning are valued.
aboutPage.missionBody: Being the bridge between talent with diverse styles and companies committed to accessibility. Through our platform: we train and acorganization candidates; we sensitize organizations to achieve more equitable selection processes. Key note: We do not adapt people to exclusionary systems; we transform workspaces to harness the richness of cognitive diversity.
aboutPage.visionBody: By 2036, to be the leading platform in labor insertion.
aboutPage.ctaBody: Whether you are talent looking for your ideal place or a organization committed to real accessibility, you will find the way at Astris.

adaptar.title: ADAPT
adaptar.body: Technology should adapt to people, not the other way around. That is why we offer a customizable interface with accessible color palettes, light and dark modes, and sensory adjustments. Each user configures the platform according to their needs, eliminating visual and cognitive barriers from the very first moment. Furthermore, companies define the adjustments they can offer before starting any process, ensuring the environment is ready to welcome diverse talent.

acompanar.title: ACCOMPANY
acompanar.body: Human accompaniment is essential for successful insertion. We assign specialized mentors who guide candidates from preparation through post-hire tracking. Our mentors understand cognitive diversity and facilitate communication between talent and companies, ensuring both parties feel supported at every stage of the process. Accompaniment doesn't end with hiring: we monitor adaptation during the first 60 to 90 days.

preparar.title: PREPARE
preparar.body: At Astris we prepare individuals to face the work environment with confidence. Through training tools, simulations, and self-knowledge, we enhance their skills and provide them with the foundation for successful incorporation. We believe knowledge and preparation are the first step towards sustainable insertion. It is not about fitting into a mold, but discovering and strengthening each person's unique capabilities so they can shine in the right environment.

conectar.title: CONNECT
conectar.body: Connecting talent with opportunities is our ultimate goal. Our matching system cross-references profiles based on skills and environmental needs to find real matches. This way we ensure the person and the work environment are compatible, generating lasting and successful relationships. Companies access anonymous profiles with objective compatibility data, without names or photos.

pillars.title: Adapt
pillars.body: The organization defines exactly what adjustments it can offer before starting any selection process.

pillars.title: Acorganization
pillars.body: A human mentor guides the candidate and the organization throughout the entire process, from the match to day 60.

pillars.title: Prepare
pillars.body: We characterize how each person works and what environment they need.

pillars.title: Connect
pillars.body: The system cross-references profiles and suggests real compatibilities, not perceptions. Both parties know what to expect.

problems: Standard selection processes are not designed to evaluate talent — they are designed to filter out differences.
Over 85% of working-age individuals with diverse cognitive styles are unemployed or underemployed, not due to lack of capabilities, but lack of compatibility.
Conventional interviews, unadapted environments, and ambiguous communication systematically exclude high-potential profiles.
A failed hire due to the absence of reasonable adjustments costs between 3 and 5 times the role's annual salary.

how.desc: The candidate characterizes their work style across 4 axes. The organization documents its environment and available adjustments.
The system cross-references both profiles and suggests compatibilities with a visible percentage for the candidate.
The mentor accompanies the preparation for the selection process, adapted to the candidate and the organization.
Post-hire, the mentor monitors adaptation during the first 60 to 90 days of the new role.

profile.affirmationTitle: How I Operate at My Best
profile.affirmationSub: Based on your cognitive profile responses
profile.axis1Affirmation: My communication is precise and structured. To maintain my quality standard, my optimal format is through email or task management platforms, minimizing verbal interruptions.
profile.axis2Affirmation: I work best when I have clarity on deadlines and goals. Well-defined autonomy lets me focus on execution without micromanagement.
profile.axis3Affirmation: My performance depends on an environment with the right stimulus level. I prefer spaces where I can control my sensory load to maintain focus.
profile.axis4Affirmation: I value environments that adapt to my needs. When workspaces and schedules consider individual differences, my productivity and well-being are maximized.
profile.axis1Low: My work benefits from asynchronous written communication. I process information better when I can review it at my own pace, without constant verbal interruptions.
profile.axis1Mid: I adapt to different communication styles. I prefer a balance between clear written instructions and occasional meetings to align expectations.
profile.axis1High: I perform best with direct verbal communication. Quick meetings and spoken feedback give me the clarity I need to move forward.
profile.axis2Low: I thrive with clear processes and defined routines. Knowing exactly what is expected of me and when gives me the structure I need to execute.
profile.axis2Mid: I work well with a balance between structure and autonomy. I enjoy having clear goals but also flexibility in deciding how to achieve them.
profile.axis2High: My best version emerges when I have freedom to organize my work. I trust my judgment to prioritize and deliver results without constant supervision.
profile.axis3Low: I need a predictable environment with few stimuli. Noise and frequent interruptions affect my deep concentration ability.
profile.axis3Mid: I adapt to different activity levels. I can focus in moderately dynamic environments, but appreciate being able to isolate when I need intense focus.
profile.axis3High: I thrive in dynamic and stimulating environments. Team energy and stimulus variety keep me engaged and creative.
profile.axis4Low: I value consistency and standardization. Knowing that processes are the same for everyone gives me security and predictability in my daily work.
profile.axis4Mid: I appreciate a balance between standardized processes and the ability to customize certain aspects of my environment when needed.
profile.axis4High: I need flexible environments that adapt to my individual needs. Customization of schedules, spaces, and tools is key to my optimal performance.
